name: guards
description: Hooks that stop destructive Bash operations, deletion of unmerged worktrees and pushes from a branch behind the default branch, and bring the local merge-target branch up to date after a merge. Repo layout rules apply only when you add a rule file

worktree_dirs.title: Folders where you keep worktrees
worktree_dirs.description: Comma-separated (e.g. ~/.worktrees). Recursive deletes under these are allowed, and paths that can't be confirmed as merged are blocked. If empty, no folder gets special treatment (deleting an unmerged worktree is blocked anywhere)
